name: @sand/git
description: Answers git questions about a project folder for the page: the current branch, changed files, unpushed commits and how far it is behind main. It fetches origin at most every 5 minutes while the page asks, and tells the page when the repo changes

sand.label: Git
sand.summary: The git branch and status of a project folder

uses.watcher: commits, checkouts and pulls made outside sand show on the page only when it gets focus again or after a minute
